pages.title: Plate Tectonics
pages.text: $(thing)Plate Tectonics$()$(br2)The crust is broken into plates that ride on the hot mantle beneath. Where they part, rock wells up; where they meet, one dives under the other. Unlocks the Core Drill - the first tool that cuts bedrock - and the way into the Planetary Interior.
$(thing)Insight$(): 60$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): Seismology, Geomorphology.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 4 Seismic Recorder Drum, 4 Sediment Core.
